d.ko: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. By playing in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. Monkeys are strong together!
d.en: Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. By playing in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. Monkeys are strong together!
d.zh: Apewar 是一款在线的策略动作射击游戏，基于现实中的猴子战争进行改编。建立你的猴子团队，与敌人作战，保卫香蕉！通过协调游戏中的战略，你可以享受游戏并获得胜利。在游戏中有许多地图选项，你可以体验到很多有趣的时刻。记住这句话：猴子们团结就是力量！
